panels.title: Phalanx Duel request rate
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Platinum · latency activity
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", count(delay_ms) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Platinum · action throughput

panels.title: Platinum · dependency activity
